customer: So with the new baby and everything, our house has been total chaos, and I was finally getting ready to sell our full-size SUV to you when I realized I have absolutely no idea where the title went. I've torn apart the filing cabinet, the glovebox, even the diaper bag drawer, and nothing. Is there any way I can still sell it, or do I need to sort out the title first? I'm in Brevin if that matters.
agent: Congratulations on the new baby, and thanks for reaching out! Since Brevin issues paper titles, you can request a duplicate by mail or at any Brevin motor vehicle office, bringing your registration and a photo ID; duplicates take 4 to 6 weeks to arrive. In the meantime you can still get an offer and book an appointment with us, though we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Offers last a limited time, so you may need a new one later, and our article "How long is my offer good for?" explains more.
